title: SeverityOverridePackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly severity-override (INV-REQ-499, INV-REQ-498): the severity override map, one escalation entry per Peppol rule, carrying the rule identifier, the specification versions it applies to, the IRAS MDE that is its subject and its citation. An entry can only escalate a Peppol warning to Block with PAY-001 (INV-REQ-498 behavior 2); there is no severity property and no enum, so the map cannot lower a severity, and there is no implicit all-versions default: every entry lists its specification versions. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by rules-svc at the pack dry run (INV-REQ-471), not here: the pair (ruleId, one specification version) is unique across escalations; each ruleId exists in the Schematron pack of that specification version and is flagged warning there; each businessTermId names a row of the MDE pack. No entry is written here; the escalation list is seed content of the severity override pack, sourced from the PINT-SG rule sets and the IRAS interpretation. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

ruleId.description: The identifier of the Schematron rule as the PINT-SG rule set names it.

specificationVersions.description: The specification versions in which the rule is escalated.

businessTermId.description: The Business Term ID of the IRAS MDE that is the subject of the rule.
